# Vela

> Vela is a statically typed scripting language for native C++ applications.
> This index helps AI assistants write Vela programs, tests, and mocks.

Vela is in active development. Use its own language and SDK contracts rather than
assuming TypeScript, JavaScript, or Dart compatibility. Examples use `.vela` files.
Paths below are relative to the repository root.

## Start here

- [Vela language, testing, and mocking reference](llms-full.txt): Self-contained
  practical guide with executable examples, common mistakes, and validation commands.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): English and Simplified Chinese topic references.
- [Runnable examples](examples/README.md): Existing programs and their expected results.
- [Language roadmap](docs/en/roadmap.md): Implemented features and remaining acceptance work.

## Language syntax and types

- [Basic contracts](docs/en/language_basics.md): Scope, nullability, switch, and diagnostics.
- [Core language](docs/en/core_language.md): Functions, classes, interfaces, enums,
  match, construction, and collections.
- [Type inference](docs/en/type_inference.md): Contextual lambdas and generic inference.
- [Generics](docs/en/generics.md): Type parameters, bounds, specialization, and invariance.
- [Modules](docs/en/modules.md): Exports, relative imports, aliases, and SDK imports.
- [Exceptions](docs/en/exceptions.md): Typed catch, throwable objects, and finally.
- [Async and Future](docs/en/async_tasks.md): Async functions, composition, and scheduling.
- [Program lifecycle](docs/zh-CN/program_lifecycle.md): Main, root Futures, and task shutdown.

## Standard APIs

- [Standard library](docs/en/standard_library.md): Default globals, Math, time, random,
  collections, and output.
- [Arrays](docs/en/arrays.md): Growable `T[]`, mutation, callbacks, and bounds.
- [Strings](docs/en/strings.md): UTF-8, interpolation, code points, and mutable builders.
- [Numeric parsing](docs/en/numeric_parse.md): Explicit string-to-number conversions.
- [String case](docs/en/string_case.md): Unicode upper/lower case conversion.
- [Regular expressions](docs/en/regexp.md): RegExp construction, matching, and captures.
- [Date and time](docs/en/time.md): Unix milliseconds, strict ISO input, and UTC conversion.
- [JSON and dynamic](docs/en/json.md): Checked dynamic operations and JSON value shapes.
- [Typed JSON](docs/en/typed_json.md): Explicit target types and constructor-based decoding.
- [Byte storage](docs/en/byte_data.md): ByteArray, ByteData views, and endianness.
- [Reflection](docs/zh-CN/reflection.md): Registration, descriptors, and checked invocation.

## Tests and mocks

- [Testing framework](docs/zh-CN/testing.md): `sdk:test`, `vela.json`, discovery,
  lifecycle hooks, matchers, async expectations, timeouts, and reporters.
- [Mock framework](docs/zh-CN/testing.md#12-mock-扩展): `sdk:mock`, interface generation,
  stubbing, argument matching, capture, verification, and async call observation.
- [Test SDK declarations](compiler/sdk/test.vela): Exact exported test and matcher APIs.
- [Mock SDK declarations](compiler/sdk/mock.vela): Exact exported mocking APIs.

Use `test()` for synchronous and asynchronous tests. Generate interface mocks with
`vela mock`; configure and verify `.calls`, pass `.object` to application code,
and manage history through `.control`. Every real mock call needs a stub, including
void methods. Create a new `MockSession` inside each test or its `setUp`.

## Tools and host integration

- [Source tools](docs/en/source_tooling.md): `vela check`, formatter, documentation, and LSP.
- [Project and test commands](docs/zh-CN/testing.md): Test configuration and CLI options.

- [C++ class bindings](docs/zh-CN/native_class_bindings.md): Typed host classes and generation.
- [Native AOT](docs/en/aot.md): Executable, object, and static-library output contracts.
